# FLX-4103: fidelity: stochastic declared with no sweep executor available

**Family:** governance/sovereignty (the 4000 band)

Simulation.spec.fidelity: stochastic (schema-declared, escalating past deterministic) requires a sweep executor that runs one Simulation per seed in `("sweep", run_index)` (KERNEL-SPEC section 3) and aggregates the results. This build ships the seed-tree primitives (`sweep_effective_seed`/`sweep_path`) but no executor yet -- run one Simulation.spec.seed at a time (fidelity: deterministic) until a sweep executor is available.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-4103
```
